name: contextunity-acdd-workflow
description: Host-neutral ACDD coordination workflow for Planner and ContextUnity.

interface.shortDescription: Coordinate Planner evidence and ContextUnity delivery.
interface.longDescription: Defines one host-neutral, evidence-bound ACDD workflow. Planner remains the task authority and ContextUnity remains the runtime authority.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the ContextUnity ACDD workflow for the current Planner task.
